questions.prompt: According to the law in Alberta, it is the driver's responsibility to ensure that all passengers under what age are properly restrained in the vehicle?
questions.explanation: The driver must make sure every passenger under 16 is wearing a seat belt or is in the correct child seat. Passengers 16 and older are responsible for themselves. Key words: "all passengers".

questions.prompt: Is a driver allowed to exceed the speed limit when passing another vehicle?
questions.explanation: The speed limit always applies, including while passing. If you can't pass without speeding, don't pass.

choices.text: Yes, but not more than 10 km/h over the speed limit
Only when passing more than one vehicle at a time

questions.prompt: In the Basic License Driver's Handbook, "nighttime" is defined as the period of time:
questions.explanation: Under Alberta's rules of the road, night time runs from one hour after sunset to one hour before the next sunrise. Headlights must be on during this time. Key words: "nighttime".

choices.text: Beginning 1 hour before sunset and ending 1 hour after the following sunrise
Beginning at sunset and ending at the following sunrise
Beginning 1 hour after sunset and ending 1 hour before the following sunrise

questions.explanation: A deceleration lane is an exit lane where you slow down after leaving the highway, instead of slowing down in the traffic lanes. Key words: "deceleration lane".

choices.text: A lane where vehicles reduce speed when exiting a highway
The right lane of a four-lane highway for use by slower moving vehicles
A lane on hills for use by slower moving vehicles
The lane immediately to the right of a solid yellow line on a highway

questions.prompt: How close can a driver legally park a vehicle to a Stop sign?
questions.explanation: You may not park within 5 metres of a stop sign, so the sign stays visible to other drivers.

questions.prompt: At what minimum distance must headlights be dimmed at night when approaching another vehicle from behind?
questions.explanation: Switch to low beams within 150 metres of a vehicle you are following, and within 300 metres of an oncoming vehicle. Key words: "dimmed", "from behind".

questions.prompt: The speed limit in a construction zone must be obeyed:
questions.explanation: A posted construction zone speed limit applies whenever the signs are up, whether or not you can see workers. Speeding fines double when workers are present.

choices.text: Only when a flag person is posted nearby
Only when construction workers are present

questions.explanation: An acceleration lane is part of an on-ramp. It lets you speed up to match highway traffic before you merge. Key words: "acceleration lane".

choices.text: The left lane of a four-lane highway, for use when passing slow moving vehicles
A lane on hills, designated for faster moving vehicles
A lane in a merge area for use by vehicles entering the highway
A lane with broken line markings

questions.prompt: A driver must report a collision to the police when anyone is injured or killed, or when the combined damage to all vehicles and property is at least:
questions.explanation: Report a collision to police if anyone is injured or killed, or if the combined damage to all vehicles and property is $5,000 or more. The limit was raised from $2,000 on January 1, 2024. Key words: "all vehicles and property".

questions.prompt: In Alberta, the law requires that seat belts must be worn:
questions.explanation: Alberta law requires seat belts to be worn and properly adjusted at all times while the vehicle is moving.

choices.text: Only when driving at highway speeds
Only when driving in the city

questions.prompt: A solid yellow line together with a broken yellow line marked on the centre of a highway means:
questions.explanation: When a solid and a broken yellow line run side by side, the line closest to you applies. If the broken line is on your side, you may pass when it is safe; if the solid line is on your side, you may not.

choices.text: If the solid line is on your side, passing is permitted
If the broken line is on your side, passing is not permitted
If the broken line is on your side, passing is permitted

questions.prompt: At 9:00 AM on a school day, what is the maximum speed permitted in a school zone in a rural area, unless otherwise posted?
questions.explanation: Unless otherwise posted, the school zone speed limit is 30 km/h during school zone hours on school days. This applies in rural areas as well as in towns and cities.

questions.prompt: Parking in a space reserved for persons with disabilities is permitted:
questions.explanation: Spaces reserved for persons with disabilities may only be used by vehicles that display a valid disabled parking placard or licence plate.

choices.text: While the driver is waiting in the vehicle
When the vehicle has a proper identifying placard or license plate
When all other parking spaces are filled
When a driver stops for less than 5 minutes

questions.prompt: What minimum distance from a fire hydrant must a vehicle be parked?
questions.explanation: You may not park within 5 metres of a fire hydrant, so firefighters can reach it quickly.

questions.prompt: Unless otherwise posted, the school zone speed limits are in effect on school days during the following hours:
questions.explanation: Unless signs show otherwise, school zone limits apply on school days from 8:00 to 9:30 am, 11:30 am to 1:30 pm, and 3:00 to 4:30 pm.

choices.text: 8:30 am to 9:30 am, 12:00 pm to 1:00 pm and 3:30 pm to 4:00 pm
8:00 am to 9:30 am, 11:30 am to 1:30 pm and 3:00 pm to 4:30 pm
